title: The Tracker: tracks, clips and the timeline
summary: The Tracker is the timeline where you arrange audio, MIDI, automation, Signal, Foley and video material on tracks.
alternateQueries: How do I use the timeline?

blocks.text: The Tracker is a timeline. Tracks run across it, one per row. Clips sit on tracks: a clip is a piece of audio, a MIDI pattern, a generated Signal sound, a Foley setup or a video. The playhead marks the current position, and the transport plays from it.
A new project's Tracker is empty ("No tracks yet"). Right-click the timeline to add a track.
A clip refers to an asset in the project; the audio itself is stored once in the project, not on the track. Deleting a clip does not delete the asset.

Each track has a header with its controls: Arm, Mon, M (mute), S (solo), FX, a Mono/ST switch, an input source, and a "..." menu of track actions. A timing bar shows the project tempo, time signature and key, with Snap and grid controls.
The Tracker shows one arrangement at a time. The tab shows its name, or Untitled, with a * when there are unsaved changes.
